title: OneDrive synced folder
whyItMatters: The synced folder mirrors work and private files to the cloud, and may hold Desktop, Documents and Pictures too. Signing out of OneDrive does not remove the local copies.
source: Microsoft Learn, OneDrive Known Folder Move and default sync folder under the user profile: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive/redirect-known-folders
notes: Personal accounts use OneDrive; work or school accounts use OneDrive - <Organization> next to it, which this rule does not match. With Known Folder Move, Desktop, Documents and Pictures live inside this folder. File placeholders may be cloud-only.
